checks_actual_results: Frontend production build passed; 41 frontend test files and 172 tests passed. Java 21 backend package started against an empty isolated MySQL schema; Flyway reached V23. Python release scripts compile and Node release scripts parse.

In Edge, the administrator created two systems and a secondary tenant, then published distinct customer and order modules in system 1. An ordinary member created, edited, listed and opened records on desktop; at 390px the member created and edited record 5, read it through API, and opened the original record detail.

The customer module published its approval action and bound Flow 1. The operator started approval instance 1, the assignee approved it on desktop, and instance 3 was approved at 390px; both reached COMPLETED. A non-assignee handling attempt returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED.

The original customer record retained uploaded file 1; downloaded bytes matched SHA-256. Desktop generated print PDF 1 and CSV export batch 1; file, PDF, CSV, database references and browser views agreed. The 390px view opened the attachment, print preview and export controls.

Target system 2 published a service contract module, Flow 2 and application 1. A source-system member read only the granted public field and started the granted Flow. Unauthorized UPDATE, target scope expansion, unrelated platform token and direct system entry were denied. Disabling the app denied subsequent calls.

Secondary tenant 3 hid main tenant data, denied entry before membership, and showed its own record on desktop and 390px after assignment. Two backend restarts reused the same JAR, DB and file root; browser, API, MySQL and stored file readbacks passed.
permission_or_failure_result: Unrelated system entry, non-assignee approval, unassigned secondary tenant entry, cross-tenant record reads, unauthorized application field/action/scope and disabled application calls were denied with expected 403/404 responses.
control_limit: Isolated test-account PBKDF2 password reset recovered browser sessions after reopen; it is environment recovery, not a product password-recovery test. Desktop generated the actual PDF/CSV; mobile verified their available controls and preview. This receipt covers the selected core release journey only.
remaining: G18_PRODUCT_RELEASE remains in progress. Versioned deployable package, complete manuals, independent install/backup/restore, non-OIDC SSO, historical print bytes in the isolated copy and full requirement traceability remain open. S18.39 stays unverified and deferred.
